component.name: metascrub
component.summary: Remove the information a file carries about you

description.p: Photographs and documents hold a second payload that has nothing to do with what they look like: GPS coordinates, camera serial numbers, the author's real name, the editing-session identifiers that link two documents to one machine. Sending a file sends all of it.
metascrub removes it, and tells you exactly what it found.

ul.li: It rebuilds files rather than editing them. Each parser copies across only what is on an explicit keep-list, so a vendor's private segment or an unknown chunk type is dropped for not being on it.
It says when it could not help. A format it cannot take apart is reported as such and returned untouched, and no output file is written.

It separates what is provable from what is not. Metadata removal is verifiable. Reducing a camera sensor fingerprint is statistical, so it lives behind a separate setting and is described in different words.

description.p: It makes no network connections of any kind, has no account and no telemetry, and never modifies your original file.
First Linux release. Desktop application and command line tool.
